'''The TH Causeway''' was a narrow strip of land between the [[Jeassa River]] and another river, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
